# Runtime notices

The portable Windows download includes the Microsoft .NET 8 and Windows Desktop runtimes so users do not need to install a separate runtime. Their supplied notices are retained here:

- `dotnet-runtime-LICENSE.txt`
- `dotnet-runtime-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`
- `windowsdesktop-runtime-LICENSE.txt`

These copies come from the 8.0.31 Windows x64 runtime packages used by this release. They describe those third-party components, not a license grant for Elka's application source.

Wireshark and Npcap are not bundled in the Elka download. Their separate official installers present their own license terms when the user chooses to install them.
